title: Research consolidation: reconcile PR225 five-stage pricing with exact intervals (no new kappa)
body:
PR225's recorded review covers four three-stage profiles at `b8e829172fc92bbbd6b1eda560ab5d99aebee0df`; its current head `830971b6b157374ebf941d0ca0b73fd2b956e3e0` adds two five-stage profiles. This research consolidation supplies the missing finite source/profile/pricing evidence and narrows the remaining question to Proposition E's referenced five-stage batched-network transfer. No new kappa or full-PR approval is claimed.

The offline capsule authenticates 70 Git objects and the complete 19-to-23-file package/workflow change, preserving all four historical rows and supplier pins. A separate directed-integer implementation derives the five-stage histograms and proves `M(a) < W < M(a + 10^-7)` for all six fixed profiles. This strengthens the original next-point check: failure of its sufficient upper-bound test alone did not establish failure of the true moment. Both unmodified original checkers also replay successfully in isolated source trees.

Reproduce:
```sh
python3 -I -O -B research/pr225-five-stage-reconciliation/verify.py
python3 -I -O -B research/pr225-five-stage-reconciliation/test_package.py
```
Expected: `PASS_PR225_FIVE_STAGE_RECONCILIATION profiles=6 added_profiles=2 next_points_rejected=6 source_files=19->23`, followed by 18 passing tests.

Validation: Python 3.14.6 and 3.9.6; exact rational interval oracles; every captured object corrupted/removed; rank-preserving histogram substitution; omitted bridge and source-binding controls; minimal offline relocation; byte-identical decompressed capsule and receipt regeneration; selected-record integrity and five tests; 14 ledger tests and full 682-entry ledger verification. Only PR225's ledger entry/link changes, with its `changed_since_review` disposition retained. A focused Linux workflow is included; hosted CI is not claimed passed.

Research base: `abdc6a7002abdbcd9e21bfc5e1a795784deacfdf`; rebased submission: `ba82555c64e1879e4b7decce28186f208fcb8262`. Main advanced from PR942 to PR1042 during the run; this PR edits neither selection. No upstream source changes, supplier rebuild, external Lean build, or all-size transfer proof. All source pins, exact intervals, controls and remaining obligations are in the package README, EXPECTED.json and VALIDATION.md.

Credit is retained for Chafik Boukhalfa (PR225/233), eumemic, Jacob Sussman, hcg890 (PR234), SovereignSteak (PR250), icekylinx, ikeboy, Ryan Shea, OpenAI and the original supplier/review lineage. Related PR250/256/304/327 concern later constructions rather than this historical evidence gap. Prepared by Ross Richardson with substantial OpenAI Codex assistance; Apache-2.0. Track: research consolidation, OS seed 97. No pinned coordination issue existed; the local claim records the scope and overlap check. Neither `codex` nor `codex-automation` is an available repository label.
